description:
Stitch Wish turns cross stitch into a calm, tap-by-tap escape. Pick a pattern, follow the colors, and watch a finished piece of pixel art appear one stitch at a time — no needles, no tangled thread, no counting mistakes.

RELAXING, FOCUSED STITCHING
• Tap a cell to place a stitch in the selected color, or hold and drag to fill a run
• Pinch to zoom and pan freely across large grids, with crisp rendering at every scale
• Undo any stitch instantly — your progress is saved as you go
• Play offline: your sessions keep working without a connection

A GROWING PATTERN CATALOG
• Browse a curated catalog of patterns, from quick minis to detailed showpieces
• Filter by size and difficulty to match the time you have
• Unlock new patterns as you play and earn Stitch Coins
• Like and revisit the ones you love

MAKE IT YOURS
• Turn your own photos into stitchable patterns with automatic color matching
• Generate original artwork from a text prompt with AI Credits, then stitch it
• Every pattern maps to real DMC-style floss colors, so a finished design is stitchable in the real world too
• Share your finished creations to the community catalog and build a creator profile

PREMIUM MEMBERSHIP
• Monthly AI Credits for new artwork
• Exclusive themes and daily coin bonuses
• Available weekly, monthly, or annually — the monthly plan starts with a 3-day free trial

Stitch Wish is designed for quiet moments: waiting rooms, commutes, or the last ten minutes of the day. There are no timers, no lives, and no way to lose. Just a grid, a palette, and a picture waiting to be finished.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://stitchwish.avkdesign.net/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://stitchwish.avkdesign.net/terms-of-service

whatsNew:
We've polished the details so stitching feels smoother and fairer every time you play.

• The locator now shows its price up front — if you're short on coins, top up in one tap and pick up right where you left off
• Daily Tasks count more fairly, and the first completion reward now works for Guests too
• Locked patterns show their price on the card; patterns you already started stay free
• Smoother panning on large patterns, plus general stability fixes
